thesis: COLM is a modest-conviction long, and only on a pullback. A margin-driven earnings beat (net income +63% on revenue +2%) triggered a high-volume gap breakout to a 52-week high. The stock sits above rising SMA20/50/200, with relative strength and a low-beta, defensive-leaning consumer profile that fits a risk-off tape better than tech. The balance sheet is sound (positive FCF, low dilution risk), and 19% short interest adds squeeze fuel. The setup is extended and consensus upside is thin, so the thesis depends on buying the 69.8-71.5 consolidation zone with the 66.9 stop, not on chasing. The news feed was down, so catalysts are inferred from timing only.
